title: Your first visit to the computer room
instructions: 原创模拟情境，非官方试题；这是独立分科短测，不是40题完整试卷。开始前不看正文、原音、词表或答案。先独立完成8题并保存原始答案，提交后再核对依据。难度是编写目标，尚未经真实考生标定。
transcript: Welcome to our computer room. My name is Anil. I am here to help you. There are ten computers. Please use computer seven today. Its screen is next to the window. Your class starts at nine thirty. We learn to send an email today. You need your phone for the class, but you do not need a book. You can get paper from the cupboard by the door. The printer costs two rupees for one page. Please ask me before you print. You can drink water here, but please eat your food outside. The room closes at four. If you leave before then, please turn off your screen.

questions.explanation: ten 是电脑总数，seven 是指定电脑编号。

Your class starts at nine thirty.
